source.competition: STEM Horizons Puzzle and Codebreakers Competition

diagram_previews.alt: Circle with the island at the bottom, the points Q1 and Q3 a quarter of the way round on either side, the antipode at the top, the upper half-circle M through the antipode drawn bold, and an arrow marking the eastward direction.

difficulty_rationale: Besides a careful refuelling schedule, the lower bound needs the observation that two planes can never both be more than a quarter of the way from the island, followed by a fuel-and-time argument at the three-quarter point.
